description: This file defines the EmployeeWorkExperienceDao class, responsible for managing database operations related to employee work experience records within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for saving, retrieving, deleting, and searching employee work experience entries.

classes.name: EmployeeWorkExperienceDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for handling CRUD operations and searches related to employee work experience entries in the database within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: saveEmployeeWorkExperience
methods.description: Saves an EmpWorkExperience object to the database, assigning a sequence number if not set, with validation.

methods.name: getEmployeeWorkExperienceById
methods.description: Retrieves an EmpWorkExperience record based on employee number and sequence number.

methods.name: getExistingEmpWorkExperienceIdsForEmpNumber
methods.description: Fetches existing sequence numbers for a given employee based on a list of IDs.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeWorkExperiences
methods.description: Deletes specified work experience records for an employee based on their sequence numbers.

methods.name: searchEmployeeWorkExperience
methods.description: Performs a search for employee work experience records based on filtering parameters and returns the results.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeWorkExperiencePaginator
methods.description: Creates and configures a paginator object for search queries.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeWorkExperiencesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of records matching search criteria.
